ch0221_00_homura/0101_0701_01_10:
Child! We keep running into each other,
don’t we.
ch0221_00_homura/0101_0701_02_10:
If you want to see me that badly, why not
join Team Magma? Ahyahyahya!
ch0221_00_homura/7101_0701_01_10:
When it comes to technology, Team Magma
surpasses all organizations!
ch0221_00_homura/7101_0701_02_10:
Child! Should you be interested in Team
Magma’s science...
ch0221_00_homura/7101_0701_03_10:
I, Tabitha, could give you some very
thorough coaching!
ch0221_00_homura/7102_0701_01_10:
Team Magma and Team Aqua committed an
offense on this island.
ch0221_00_homura/7102_0701_02_10:
We intend to continue to atone for the sins
we have committed.
ch0221_00_homura/7102_0701_03_10:
Because that is what it means to be a
responsible adult.
ch0221_00_homura/7103_0701_01_10:
Ahyahya! Capable people are quick to
succeed!
ch0221_00_homura/7103_0701_02_10:
I am highly praised within Team Magma for
my scientific contributions and leadership!
ch0221_00_homura/7103_0701_03_10: That’s what I assume, at least!
ch0221_00_homura/7104_0701_01_10:
Team Aqua has a lot of muscleheads, but
there are some who seem reasonable.
ch0221_00_homura/7104_0701_02_10:
As of now, Team Magma and Team Aqua
have a truce on Pasio.
ch0221_00_homura/7104_0701_03_10:
A technical exchange to invigorate the
organizations might not be a bad idea!
ch0221_00_homura/7105_0701_01_10:
Child! I’ll tell you something, but keep it
between us!
ch0221_00_homura/7105_0701_02_10:
To tell the truth, I, Tabitha, used to be an
employee of the Devon Corporation!
ch0221_00_homura/7105_0701_03_10:
You must wonder how an elite like me
ended up joining Team Magma!
ch0221_00_homura/7105_0701_04_10:
Well...that’s a story for another day!
Ahyahyahya!
ch0221_00_homura/1701_0701_01_10: Have a present, child! You must accept it!
ch0221_00_homura/1701_0702_01_10:
It’s a present from THE Tabitha! You’d better
treasure it!
ch0221_00_homura/2501_0701_01_10:
I’m working out many policies to ensure
Team Magma’s long-term operation.
ch0221_00_homura/2501_0701_02_10:
If it were just Leader Maxie and me, cracks
would eventually show.
ch0221_00_homura/2501_0701_03_10:
While I hold Courtney’s skills in high regard,
as an admin, I do have some concerns.
ch0221_00_homura/2501_0701_04_10:
In other words, we lack enough pieces
for the puzzle!
ch0221_00_homura/2501_0702_02_10:
which is why Team Magma decided to
recruit a wide range of talent!
ch0221_00_homura/2501_0702_03_10:
How about it? Our benefits and pay are
more generous than any other organization’s!
ch0221_00_homura/2511_0701_01_10:
The pursuit of a world ideal for humanity...
That is Team Magma’s founding principle.
ch0221_00_homura/2511_0701_02_10:
And there is no greater means for progress
than science!
ch0221_00_homura/2511_0701_03_10: It is a great power granted to us.
ch0221_00_homura/2511_0702_01_10:
I will continue to put my efforts toward
the development of science!
ch0221_00_homura/2511_0702_02_10:
It’s only a matter of time until Team
Magma’s scientific prowess carves out
a new future! Ahyahyahya!
ch0221_00_homura/3001_0701_01_10:
You are—how shall I put this—VERY
energetic for this early in the morning.
ch0221_00_homura/3003_0701_01_10:
The sunlight that shines down on us is a true
blessing! It’s important that we enjoy it!
ch0221_00_homura/3005_0701_01_10:
Is it that late already? Well, worry not.
Team Magma never rests!
